text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor verification, helps ensure that only the right people can access an account. Developers must also validate all user input to stop malicious code from entering the system. Without these steps, websites can suffer from common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which may lead to data theft. By focusing on security from the start, developers build safer and more trustworthy applications.
